name: Castro Marim
mandate: PrompTugal.news Castro Marim: AI and technology in Castro Marim, a salt-pan and Guadiana border town where the AI sits in its council's planning office and its salt works, and what reaches Castro Marim from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent, and every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Castro Marim is a small municipality on the Guadiana, next to Spain, whose economy and identity rest on the traditional salt pans of the Sapal nature reserve, on tourism and on cross-border cooperation in the Eurocidade do Guadiana. Its AI is not a cluster but two concrete cases: a council modernising its planning office with a vendor's AI-ready software, and a salt-works family that built a software platform with an AI assistant for artisanal salt producers.

ai_news.title: A Castro Marim salt family launches SalOS, a platform with an AI assistant for salt makers
ai_news.summary: A platform built from the work of a Castro Marim salt works manages harvest, lab, stock, sales and traceability for artisanal sea salt on a phone or computer. Press coverage says it includes a digital assistant for operational questions and a tool for sluice and salinity management. Free trial for producers.
ai_news.ai_path: A local company ships a software product with an AI assistant (Marnoto AI, per the press). The product's own Spanish page lists the modules but does not mention the AI assistant, so the AI claim rests on press coverage.
ai_news.significance_why: The platform is open to any artisanal sea-salt producer in Portugal, built in Castro Marim.

ai_news.title: SalOS is also covered as a traceability platform ready for the EU Digital Product Passport
ai_news.summary: The same launch, reported on 7 July: one program for harvest, laboratory, quality, warehouse, sales and invoicing, a QR code on each pack, and a digital assistant for operational questions. The article does not name the company behind the software.
ai_news.ai_path: The platform has an AI digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool, built in Castro Marim.
ai_news.significance_why: Same national launch, reported by a national business paper.

ai_news.title: Castro Marim's council puts AI into its planning office roadmap with Mind
ai_news.summary: At the council's municipal day session on 24 June 2026 the software company Mind presented a phased digital urban planning project. The document system is being introduced now. A later phase adds an online planning service with AI that helps people complete requests before they reach council staff. The dates are the vendor's own plan.
ai_news.ai_path: A Portuguese council plans a public service that uses AI, and its current step is the software that prepares for it. Source is the vendor, not independent press.
ai_news.significance_why: One council's own rollout. The vendor serves many councils, but nothing here is specific to other Algarve towns.

ai_news.title: Eurocidade do Guadiana tourism pitch made with AI avatars of three mayors, Castro Marim's among them
ai_news.summary: In January 2024 Ayamonte presented a pilot AI video that recreates the mayors of Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António and Castro Marim promoting the cross-border area in several languages at once. Older than our usual window but the only cross-border AI project that includes Castro Marim.
ai_news.ai_path: Three councils, Castro Marim's included, used generative AI to promote tourism. The page is partly garbled, so details are limited.
ai_news.significance_why: A pilot shared by Castro Marim, Vila Real de Santo António and Ayamonte, the Eurocidade partners across the border.

ai_map.what: Traceability and operations platform for artisanal salt producers, born inside the Sapal de Castro Marim reserve, with a free 30 day trial. Press describes a digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
ai_map.what: The council is introducing a digital planning document system and, per the vendor, plans an online planning service with AI. Its own urbanismo page lists a GeoPortal and online services and does not mention AI.

ai_map.name: Mind (ePaper)
ai_map.what: Portuguese software vendor whose ePaper urban planning system is going into Castro Marim. It also markets an AI agent, Agente ePaper IA, that answers planning questions in natural language, reported on its own news page on 13 October 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Vendor of an AI agent product and of the AI-ready software the council is adopting. Not based in Castro Marim as far as we saw, listed because it supplies the town.

ai_map.name: Eurocidade do Guadiana (Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António, Castro Marim)
ai_map.what: Cross-border grouping of three councils that presented a pilot AI avatar video for tourism in January 2024, led by Ayamonte. Castro Marim's council president took part.
ai_map.ai_path: A grouping that includes Castro Marim used generative AI for tourism promotion.

extras.label: Council notices, 10 November 2026
extras.value: The council announced a warning to the population and the closing of non-essential services because of Depression Charles.

gaps: AI news is thin: in a search of the council's news pages (September to November 2026) we found no headline about AI or technology. The two local AI stories both come from July 2026 and one rests on the vendor's own page.

SalOS's press coverage (Barlavento, Jornal Económico) reports an AI assistant (Marnoto AI) and a water support tool, but neither salos.net's Spanish page nor its main page mentions AI (they list automatic DOP validation and FIFO allocation). We should ask the company before treating the AI claim as settled.

We could not open Jornal do Algarve (403), Postal do Algarve (bot challenge) or Sul Informação (403), so their Castro Marim coverage is missing. The Sul Informação leads are not followed: that site is not read by this desk.
The council site has no RSS or Atom feed that we could find, so Castro Marim cannot be followed automatically yet.
University of Algarve work in the salt pans (CCMAR's SAL+) and CRIA's 2022 blue innovation contest are real local innovation but we saw no AI in them, so they stay out of the map for now.
No AI or tech events found in Castro Marim: the council agenda lists only cultural, sporting and local events. No Algarve Evolution member or startup base found in the municipality yet.
We have not found a data centre, an AI research group, an AI training course or an AI investor in the municipality.

The council's incubation space (Edifício Multifuncional de Empresas) describes itself as for innovative, scalable projects but its page mentions no digital, tech or AI focus, and we found no company in it with an AI link.

Investors: we found no investor, fund or investment in a Castro Marim company in public sources. The only funding trace is council projects, so the investment map is empty here, which is itself a finding.

Local talent: we found no publicly speaking AI or tech person tied to Castro Marim, and the council business page names no desk or contact for entrepreneurs beyond its general office. A named business-support contact would help a founder starting here.
No council meeting decisions and no new salt or SalOS item on the pages opened on 16 November; the fetch tool summarises pages, so dates should be rechecked on the live pages.
A police investigation into a death in Altura (Postal, 15 November) is not used: a crime story about a private individual.
cm-castromarim.pt answered 403 on 18 November (it loaded on 16 and 17 November); no new Castro Marim item was found.

voice.lede: Cá em Castro Marim the salt dries in the sun and the AI, ó pá, still has to be asked to come up from the car park.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Castro Marim: we are the last town before Espanha, so we watch the AI coming over the Guadiana like a flamingo watching the tide. Salt pans, a council with a clever planning office and a family that taught a salt works to talk back. What comes from the Algarve, Portugal and the world gets weighed here like flor de sal, by the gram. Independent, and every fact has its source.
voice.gravity: Small town, big sky, lots of salt. Our money is in the pans of the Sapal, in visitors and in neighbourly dealings with Espanha across the river. Our AI, to be fair, is not a crowd, it is two cases: the Câmara tidying its planning papers with software that will one day answer citizens, and a salt family that built an app so clever it has an assistant.
voice.gaps_intro: Honestly, meu amigo, here is what we could not find, and it is a lot, like looking for shade at two in the afternoon in August:

The council publishes the operating regulation, an application form and an information leaflet.

local_news.title: Castro Marim hosts the third Algarve Alzheimer and dementia congress, with an AI and cognitive-training session and a local care-technology start-up
local_news.summary: On 12 and 13 November, in the Biblioteca Municipal auditorium, full house, theme 'Demências: Ciência que orienta, Intervenção que transforma', organised by the José Cabrita residence with the council and the University of Algarve. Day one included a talk on 'Inteligência Artificial e Neuroestimulação: Aplicações Clínicas e Futuro do Treino Cognitivo' and one on assistive technology; the council highlights Rico Health, a system and digital platform made by two Castro Marim founders to support active ageing, monitoring of elderly or isolated people and the work of carers. The council page does not describe how the AI session or Rico Health use AI; the talk title is the only AI claim.
local_news.ai_path: Public data from sensors and care records (Rico Health's monitoring), analytics and AI training tools (the congress session on AI and neurostimulation), clinicians and carers (the José Cabrita residence and the University of Algarve). The council page names the talk and the platform, not their AI methods.
local_news.blast_radius: Vila Real de Santo António, Tavira, and the whole Algarve (regional congress)

local_news.title: Castro Marim renews the quay of the Sapal nature reserve, with FEDER funding
local_news.summary: Total investment 683,599.01 euros (594,175.47 eligible), FEDER up to 60%. The same application covers a salt-pan warehouse, the Revelim interpretation centre and a Biosphere Reserve candidacy for the reserve, which Vila Real de Santo António shares.
local_news.blast_radius: Vila Real de Santo António (shared reserve)

local_news.title: Works start on the Castro Marim health centre, backed by Algarve 2030
local_news.summary: Energy efficiency, accessibility and solar panels; services move temporarily to the former Azinhal health centre. The council says the state's competence transfer did not include the financial instruments, so it found alternative funding.

local_news.title: Castro Marim's basic school climbs 264 places in the national 9th-grade ranking
local_news.summary: From 1,039th (2024) to 775th (2025), data from Nova SBE; the 'CM Educa+' programme uses a digital learning platform developed by the University of Algarve. The page does not say the platform uses AI.
local_news.ai_path: No AI stated: council and school grouping, University of Algarve digital platform, pupils.

local_news.title: 'Jovens pelo Ambiente' wins first place in the Algarve youth-volunteering award
local_news.summary: Handed over on 14 November; the council project runs with the Young Link association under an IPDJ programme, with litter collection and planting in the Sapal reserve.

local_news.title: Castro Marim closed non-essential council services on 11 November for storm Charles
local_news.summary: The government declared an alert for 11 November on an IPMA forecast; civil protection, telephone service and social action kept running.

local_news.title: Castro Marim's alert notice for storm Charles lists red wind, orange rain and orange sea warnings for 11 November
local_news.summary: IPMA warnings: red wind with gusts to 120 km/h (up to 140 in exposed areas), orange rain 05:00 to 18:00, orange sea with swell of 5 to 7 m. Schools and public services closed; access to parks, forests and the shore was prohibited. The council's civil protection line is published on the page.
local_news.blast_radius: Vila Real de Santo António and Alcoutim under the same warnings

local_news.title: Castro Marim launches 'Vila Coração', a new Christmas brand, from 28 November
local_news.summary: Lighting ceremony at 17:30 in Praça 1.º de Maio on 28 November; the programme runs to 9 January 2027 across the municipality and invites residents to decorate homes and windows.

local_news.title: The Great World Race now stops in Altura on 19 November at 18:00
local_news.summary: Bad weather in Antarctica changed the timing of the seven-continent marathon series; the Altura stop starts on Avenida 24 de Junho and runs into the night.

local_news.title: Castro Marim's José Cabrita residence for neurodegenerative diseases has 70 users
local_news.summary: The Santa Casa da Misericórdia's residence and day centre uses outings, yoga, flamenco and cognitive exercises rather than mainly medication, and is described as the first of its kind in the south. This is the only Alzheimer's-related item found; it says nothing about the dementia congress claimed earlier.
local_news.blast_radius: Vila Real de Santo António, Tavira

local_news.title: Castro Marim opens the procedure to draft a regulation on municipal tax benefits
local_news.summary: An edital published on 16 November starts the drafting of a regulation granting municipal tax benefits, relevant to business and investment. The full text is a PDF that was not opened, so the way to take part and the deadline are unknown.
